purpose: A circular progress indicator for a value from 0 to 100, for places a bar does not fit: a button, a card corner, an avatar.

notFor.case: There is room for a horizontal bar.
A measured value against a range.

Default.visual: Ring Surface/muted; arc from the top Action/primary/default (solid), with round or butt caps.

notes: Give it an accessible name (aria-label); show the percentage next to it when it matters.

openQuestions: Indeterminate: no look is designed. What does it show?
The gradient appearance has no arc role in the contract bindings. Which roles does the gradient arc use?
ProgressCircle has no motion while ProgressLine moves on use-progress. Should the arc animate value changes too?
